subject.title: fix: user-pinned model falls back to global chain on quota exhaustion

question: Should user-sourced and legacy model pins become quota-only fallback preferences while remaining strict for transient failures?
rationale: That changes persisted session-selection semantics and can route a pinned session through different provider/auth profiles after upgrade, so code correctness alone does not settle the product contract.

options.title: Accept quota-only fallback after repair
options.body: Allow pinned models to recover from long-term quota or subscription exhaustion once the cooldown and matcher blockers are fixed and after-fix proof is supplied.

options.title: Keep exact pins strict
options.body: Preserve the current documented exact-selection contract and solve recovery through explicit user action, doctor/setup guidance, or a separate opt-in policy.

options.title: Broaden user-pin fallback
options.body: Treat user pins as preferences for more provider failures, but require a broader compatibility design and tests before merging.

recommendation.title: Accept quota-only fallback after repair
recommendation.body: Allow pinned models to recover from long-term quota or subscription exhaustion once the cooldown and matcher blockers are fixed and after-fix proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has central fallback-history context and recent merge ownership around the affected agent files.
